## Summary

Describe the issue or request in one short paragraph.

## Evidence

- failing test
- replay artifact
- IR snippet
- log excerpt
- command line

## Impact

- correctness
- performance
- integration

- contracts
- safety

## Requested Action

State exactly what you want the receiving team to do.

Do not request permission to modify another team's area unless the owner explicitly invites it.

## Boundaries

Example:

```text
The Passes Team will not modify compiler/ir/core.
```
